fail_closed: Do not launch until all three ten-second-spaced resource samples pass before every point.
Do not change flattening, compile commands, compile effort, point order, top, ports, SDC, libraries, RTL or tool version relative to r2.
Any OOM, DC fatal, unresolved reference, missing report, setup/hold failure or electrical violation fails the complete r3 run.
Do not combine partial r2/r3 points or cite r2 as PPA.
M496_DC_RUN is forbidden; the canonical run directory and contract-level attempt marker prevent directory-renamed retries.
Once the first K1 dc_shell launch is attempted, the r3 replay is consumed even if DC or the host later fails.
The 4.764209x value is frozen H67 FC2 frontend cycle evidence, not a full-network speedup.
K1x8 is eightfold bandwidth scaling, not a same-resource baseline.
Logic-only pre-macro DC is not paper-ready chip PPA, complete FFN or system speedup.
